typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		mve_gkey as long,
		Unit_Nbr as string,
		Facility_Id as string,
		Complex_Id as string,
		Yard_Id as string,
		Carrier_Visit_Key as string,
		Carrier_Service as string,
		Event_Type_Id as string,
		Move_Kind as string,
		From_Location as string,
		To_Location as string,
		From_Position_Name as string,
		To_Position_Name as string,
		Carry_CHE_Operator_Id as string,
		Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id as string,
		Put_CHE_Operator_Id as string,
		Fetch_CHE_Id as long,
		Fetch_CHE_Kind as string,
		Carry_CHE_Id as long,
		Carry_CHE_Kind as string,
		Put_CHE_Id as long,
		Put_CHE_Kind as string,
		QC_CHE_Id as long,
		QC_CHE_Kind as string,
		Unit_POD as string,
		t_carry_complete as timestamp,
		t_put as timestamp,
		t_fetch as timestamp,
		t_dispatch as timestamp,
		t_discharge as timestamp,
		t_carry_dispatch as timestamp,
		t_carry_fetch_ready as timestamp,
		t_carry_put_ready as timestamp,
		dist_carry as string,
		dist_start as string,
		Twin_Fetch as boolean,
		Twin_Carry as boolean,
		Twin_Put as boolean,
		Category_Id as string,
		Freight_Kind_Id as string,
		to_pos_gkey as string,
		fm_pos_gkey as string,
		Restow_Reason as string,
		Container_Line_Id as string,
		Container_Line_Role as string,
		pow as string,
		ufv_gkey as integer,
		Berth_Id as string,
		Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg as integer,
		active_ufv as integer,
		Requires_Power_Flag as boolean,
		OOG_Flag as boolean,
		Shipper_Id as string,
		Consignee_Id as string,
		Commodity_Id as string,
		ATA as timestamp,
		ATD as timestamp,
		Rehandles as string,
		Year as integer,
		Month as integer,
		Week as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'til-namibia',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves') ~> source1
source1 filter(equals(Carry_CHE_Kind,'ITV') && like(pow, '%STS%')) ~> Filter1
Filter1 derive(CarryCompleteTime = toString(t_carry_complete,'HH:mm:ss'),
		CarryCompleteDate = toDate(toString(t_carry_complete, 'yyyy-MM-dd')),
		CarryCompleteHour = toInteger(split(toString(t_put,'HH:mm:ss'),":")[1])) ~> DerivedColumn2
sort1 aggregate(groupBy(Carry_CHE_Id,
		CarryCompleteDate,
		CarryCompleteHour),
	First_Lift = min(t_carry_complete),
		Last_Lift = max(t_carry_complete),
		Move_Count = countDistinct(mve_gkey)) ~> Aggregate1
Aggregate1 derive(WorkTime = iif((isNull(Last_Lift) || isNull(First_Lift) || isNull(:LiftDiff) || :LiftDiff<=0 || :LiftDiff >=3600000),:WorkSeconds,:LiftDiff),
		Year = iifNull(year(CarryCompleteDate),0),
		Month = iifNull(month(CarryCompleteDate),0),
		Week = iifNull(weekOfYear(CarryCompleteDate),0),
		LiftDiff = :LiftDiff,
		WorkSeconds = :WorkSeconds,
		LiftDiff := toInteger(Last_Lift-First_Lift),
		WorkSeconds := iif(Move_Count>=1,3600000,0)) ~> DerivedColumn4
DerivedColumn4 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
DerivedColumn2 sort(asc(Carry_CHE_Id, true),
	asc(t_put, true)) ~> sort1
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'til-namibia',
	folderPath: 'gold/tt_productivity',
	mergeSchema: true,
	autoCompact: true,
	optimizedWrite: true,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['Carry_CHE_Id','CarryCompleteDate','CarryCompleteHour'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('key',
		0,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week
	)) ~> sink1
